title: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Imagine counting thirty-four pencils one by one. Phew! It is much easier in bundles of ten. Look at the blocks on the board: long sticks and tiny cubes.

draw.text: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: base-ten blocks. Look at the thousand, the hundreds and the tens. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.

draw.text: Tens and ones with place value blocks

explain.say: Look at one long stick. It is ten little cubes joined together, so we call it a ten. Can you hold up ten fingers to make a ten?
Thirty-four has three tens. Count the sticks in tens: ten, twenty, thirty. The 3 in 34 tells you how many tens. Can you count them with me?
Now add the ones: four little cubes. Thirty and four make thirty-four. The 4 tells you how many ones. Can you see the 3 tens and the 4 ones?

Here is a puzzle. Forty-three uses the same digits, a 4 and a 3. But now there are four tens and three ones. Where a digit sits changes what it is worth! Brilliant! Challenge: build your age with sticks and cubes.

faq.a: Place value means a digit is worth different amounts depending on where it sits. In 34, the 3 means three tens, and the 4 means four ones.
A ten stick is ten small cubes joined in a line. It shows ten in one piece, so you can count in tens.
Ones are the single small cubes. In 34, there are four ones.
They use the same digits, but in different places. 34 is three tens and four ones. 43 is four tens and three ones, so it is bigger.

faq.q: Can I make my own place value blocks?
faq.a: Yes! Bundle ten straws or lolly sticks with a band to make a ten, and keep single ones loose. A teacher or grown-up can help.
asks: How do I make tens at home?

facts: In 34, the digit 3 is worth 30 and the digit 4 is worth 4.

quiz.why: The 5 in 52 sits in the tens place, so there are five tens.

wrong.1: The 2 tells you the ones, not the tens.
wrong.2: 52 is the whole number: five tens and two ones.

quiz.say: Which number is 4 tens and 3 ones?
quiz.why: Four tens are forty, and three ones make forty-three.

wrong.1: 34 is three tens and four ones.
wrong.2: Seven would be four ones and three ones, but these are tens.
